Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import msal
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional

def start_oidc_authorization_code_flow(
    client_id: str,
    client_secret: str,
    tenant_id: str,
    redirect_uri: str,
    scopes: Optional[List[str]] = None
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if scopes is None:
        scopes = ["openid", "profile", "email"]

    authority = f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant_id}"
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        client_id=client_id,
        client_credential=client_secret,
        authority=authority
    )

    flow = app.initiate_auth_code_flow(
        scopes=scopes,
        redirect_uri=redirect_uri
    )

    return {
        "authorization_url": flow["auth_uri"],
        "state": flow["state"],
        "nonce": flow["nonce"],
        "code_verifier": flow.get("code_verifier")
    }
